values.note: Camping reservations by phone, 607-590-0535; the county opens the season's reservations in early January (January 5 for 2026).

booking.source: https://www.steubencountyny.gov/Facilities/Facility/Details/Kanakadea-Park-1 ('For Camping Reservations, call 607-590-0535'; 'Reservations for the 2025 Camping Season will begin January 5, 2026'), read 2026-10-21

season.source: https://www.steubencountyny.gov/Facilities/Facility/Details/Kanakadea-Park-1 ('Camping Season: April 15 to December 1'; 'Water Available April 15 to October 15'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 40 electric and 30 non-electric campsites; the 2026 site map marks some electric sites with a gravel pad 25 ft long by 12 ft wide.

sites.source: https://www.steubencountyny.gov/Facilities/Facility/Details/Kanakadea-Park-1 ('40 Electric and 30 Non-Electric Campsites') + https://www.steubencountyny.gov/DocumentCenter/View/8657 (2026 site map legend 'G - CAMPSITE HAS ELECTRIC, AND GRAVEL PAD 25'L X 12'W'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 40 sites have electric; the county does not state the amperage.

hookups.source: https://www.steubencountyny.gov/Facilities/Facility/Details/Kanakadea-Park-1 ('40 Electric and 30 Non-Electric Campsites'; no amperage stated), read 2026-10-21. The stored 50 A came from the note's '30/50A', which only aggregator listings (Campendium) support.

facilities.source: https://www.steubencountyny.gov/Facilities/Facility/Details/Kanakadea-Park-1 ('Flush Toilets and Hot Showers'; 'Dumping Station ($10 for non-campers)'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Campsites $19 a night without electric, $27 with ($115 / $170 weekly); cabins $60-69. 10% off for seniors (62+) and veterans. County rate schedule, read 2026-10-21.

fees.source: https://www.steubencountyny.gov/Facilities/Facility/Details/Kanakadea-Park-1 (Rate Schedule: Nightly No Electric $19, Electric $27), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 10% discount to veterans and to senior citizens 62 and up.

discounts.source: https://www.steubencountyny.gov/Facilities/Facility/Details/Kanakadea-Park-1 ('10% Discount to Senior Citizens (62 years and up)'; '10% Discount to Veterans'), read 2026-10-21

note: Steuben County park on Almond Lake (USACE reservoir). 2 cabins, trailer boat launches (no motors); some lake-view sites. --Claude
summary: Confirmed phone reservations (607-590-0535), season Apr 15-Dec 1, 70 sites (40 electric / 30 not), $19/$27, dump. Added water on Apr 15-Oct 15, showers and flush toilets, 10% veteran and senior discounts. Cleared electric 50 A: the county states electric sites but no amperage (the 30/50A came only from aggregators). Note trimmed of counts, hookups, booking and season.
